provenance.scope: Data commission. Source assets remain read-only.

studs.line_en: Leonardo da Vinci is born. His grandfather records the date and the third hour of the night.
studs.line_de: Leonardo da Vinci wird geboren. Sein Großvater notiert das Datum und die dritte Stunde der Nacht.
studs.document: Note in the hand of his grandfather Antonio da Vinci: "Nacque un mio nipote, figliuolo di ser Piero mio figliuolo, a dì 15 aprile in sabato, a ore 3 di notte. Ebbe nome Lionardo." Archivio di Stato di Firenze

studs.line_en: Tradition places his birth at Anchiano. His grandfather's note names no place.
studs.line_de: Der Überlieferung nach wird er in Anchiano geboren. Die Notiz seines Großvaters nennt keinen Ort.
studs.document: none. The grandfather's note names no place
gaps: Present document holder not established by the cited catalog row.

studs.line_en: A Florentine household declaration lists him as ser Piero's illegitimate son, aged seventeen.
studs.line_de: Eine Florentiner Haushaltserklärung führt ihn als unehelichen Sohn des ser Piero auf, siebzehn Jahre alt.
studs.document: Catasto declaration: "Lionardo, figl[i]uolo di detto ser Piero non legiptimo, d'età d'anni 17"

studs.line_en: He probably trains in Verrocchio's workshop between about 1466 and 1472. No apprenticeship contract survives.
studs.line_de: Wahrscheinlich lernt er zwischen etwa 1466 und 1472 in Verrocchios Werkstatt. Ein Lehrvertrag ist nicht erhalten.
studs.document: no contract survives. The guild entry of 1472 is the earliest hard anchor
gaps: Present document holder not established by the cited catalog row.

studs.line_en: His name enters the records of Florence's painters' company.
studs.line_de: Sein Name erscheint in den Aufzeichnungen der Florentiner Malerbruderschaft.
studs.document: the company's "Libro Rosso de' debitori e creditori"
gaps: Present document holder not established by the cited catalog row.

studs.line_en: He dates a drawing of the Arno valley.
studs.line_de: Er datiert eine Zeichnung des Arnotals.
studs.document: Leonardo's own inscription on the sheet, Gallerie degli Uffizi, GDSU inv. 8 P recto
studs.holder: Gallerie degli Uffizi, GDSU, 8 P recto

studs.line_en: An anonymous accusation names him and three others in a sodomy case. An accusation is not a finding of guilt.
studs.line_de: Eine anonyme Anzeige nennt ihn und drei weitere Männer in einem Sodomieverfahren. Eine Anzeige belegt keine Schuld.
studs.document: notarised copy among the records of the Ufficiali di Notte e Conservatori dei Monasteri, Archivio di Stato di Firenze

studs.line_en: The renewed accusation is dismissed and the accused are absolved.
studs.line_de: Die erneute Anzeige wird zurückgewiesen, die Beschuldigten werden freigesprochen.
studs.document: same series

studs.line_en: The Signoria commissions an altarpiece. The January day differs between the cited chronologies.
studs.line_de: Die Signoria bestellt ein Altarbild. Die zitierten Chronologien nennen unterschiedliche Januartage.
studs.document: the Signoria's deliberation; advance of 25 gold florins paid 16 Mar 1478

date_alternatives.note: Competing January day. Commission retained without pretending date resolved.

studs.qualifications_en: The payment of 16 March is a separate event. January 1 and 10 remain competing readings.
studs.qualifications_de: Die Zahlung vom 16. März ist ein eigener Vorgang. Für Januar stehen der 1. und der 10. Tag nebeneinander.
gaps: Present document holder not established by the cited catalog row.
Competing date readings preserved in date_alternatives.

studs.line_en: He notes that he has begun two Madonnas. The month is incomplete.
studs.line_de: Er notiert, dass er zwei Madonnen begonnen hat. Der Monat ist unvollständig überliefert.
studs.document: Leonardo's own note on a drawing in the Uffizi (GDSU 446 E, verify)
gaps: Document locator or original record not verified. Read document and qualifications before presenting certainty.

studs.line_en: The Adoration commission is recorded in 1481. Its starting date and completion term need qualification.
studs.line_de: Der Auftrag zur Anbetung ist 1481 belegt. Beginn und Ausführungsfrist sind unterschiedlich überliefert.
studs.document: the convent's contract
studs.source_url: https://www.treccani.it/enciclopedia/leonardo-da-vinci_(Dizionario-Biografico)/). An older chronology dates the San Donato commission to March 1480 ([it.wikisource](https://it.wikisource.org/wiki/Trattato_della_pittura_(Leonardo_da_Vinci)/Prospetto_cronologico)

date_alternatives.source: Older chronology linked by LIFE catalog

date_alternatives.note: Commission date differs from the July record.

studs.qualifications_en: July is the catalog’s record date. Do not turn it into a settled award date or a settled two-year deadline. The holder gives 30 months, against the catalog’s two years.
studs.qualifications_de: Juli ist das im Katalog genannte Belegdatum. Es ist kein gesicherter Vergabetermin und belegt keine eindeutige Zweijahresfrist. Das besitzende Museum nennt 30 Monate, der Katalog zwei Jahre.

sources.url: https://www.treccani.it/enciclopedia/leonardo-da-vinci_(Dizionario-Biografico)/). An older chronology dates the San Donato commission to March 1480 ([it.wikisource](https://it.wikisource.org/wiki/Trattato_della_pittura_(Leonardo_da_Vinci)/Prospetto_cronologico)

gaps: Present document holder not established by the cited catalog row.
Competing date readings preserved in date_alternatives.

contract_term_alternatives.source: Holder record cited by the governing cross-check

contract_term_alternatives.source_url: https://www.treccani.it/enciclopedia/leonardo-da-vinci_(Dizionario-Biografico)/). An older chronology dates the San Donato commission to March 1480 ([it.wikisource](https://it.wikisource.org/wiki/Trattato_della_pittura_(Leonardo_da_Vinci)/Prospetto_cronologico)
contract_term_alternatives.source: Two years in the LIFE catalog. Contract not collated.

studs.line_en: He probably moves to Milan around this year.
studs.line_de: Wahrscheinlich zieht er um dieses Jahr nach Mailand.
studs.document: no travel record. The Virgin of the Rocks contract of 25 Apr 1483 is the first hard Milan document
gaps: Present document holder not established by the cited catalog row.

studs.line_en: An undated draft offers Ludovico Sforza his services as an engineer and artist.
studs.line_de: Ein undatierter Entwurf bietet Ludovico Sforza seine Dienste als Ingenieur und Künstler an.
studs.document: a draft, undated, in a copyist's hand with Leonardo's corrections. Codex Atlanticus f. 1082 recto (old numbering f. 391 recto-a), Biblioteca Ambrosiana, Milan

studs.line_en: He and the de Predis brothers sign the Virgin of the Rocks contract.
studs.line_de: Er und die Brüder de Predis unterzeichnen den Vertrag zur Felsgrottenmadonna.
studs.document: the notarial contract, Milan
gaps: Present document holder not established by the cited catalog row.

studs.line_en: Milan cathedral's accounts record work on a model for its crossing tower.
studs.line_de: Die Rechnungen des Mailänder Doms verzeichnen Arbeiten an einem Modell für den Vierungsturm.
studs.document: cathedral fabric payments
studs.holder: Veneranda Fabbrica del Duomo di Milano

studs.line_en: He begins a book on light and shade and writes that he has resumed the horse.
studs.line_de: Er beginnt ein Buch über Licht und Schatten und notiert, dass er die Arbeit am Pferd wieder aufgenommen hat.
studs.document: Leonardo's dated note, Paris Ms. C, Institut de France (manuscript confirmed, folio still to verify)
studs.holder: Bibliothèque de l’Institut de France, Paris Ms C
gaps: Document locator or original record not verified. Read document and qualifications before presenting certainty.

studs.line_en: Giacomo, later called Salaì, enters his household.
studs.line_de: Giacomo, später Salaì genannt, kommt in seinen Haushalt.
studs.document: Leonardo's note, same manuscript group (folio verify). The Magdalene's feast is 22 July
gaps: Document locator or original record not verified. Read document and qualifications before presenting certainty.
Present document holder not established by the cited catalog row.

studs.line_en: The clay horse is displayed for the Sforza wedding festivities.
studs.line_de: Das Tonmodell des Pferdes wird zu den Hochzeitsfeierlichkeiten der Sforza gezeigt.
studs.document: Milanese court records
gaps: Present document holder not established by the cited catalog row.

studs.line_en: Ludovico diverts the bronze reserved for the horse to cannon making.
studs.line_de: Ludovico lässt die für das Pferd vorgesehene Bronze für Kanonen verwenden.
studs.document: Sforza correspondence
gaps: Present document holder not established by the cited catalog row.

studs.line_en: The court presses him to finish the Last Supper.
studs.line_de: Der Hof drängt ihn, das Abendmahl fertigzustellen.
studs.document: ducal note
gaps: Present document holder not established by the cited catalog row.

studs.line_en: Luca Pacioli describes the Last Supper as finished.
studs.line_de: Luca Pacioli beschreibt das Abendmahl als vollendet.
studs.document: Luca Pacioli's dedication to De divina proportione
gaps: Present document holder not established by the cited catalog row.

studs.line_en: A secretary reports his promise to finish the Sala delle Asse by September.
studs.line_de: Ein Sekretär berichtet von seinem Versprechen, die Sala delle Asse bis September fertigzustellen.
studs.document: letter of the ducal secretary (Gualtiero da Bascapè) to Ludovico
gaps: Present document holder not established by the cited catalog row.

studs.line_en: Ludovico grants him a vineyard outside Porta Vercellina.
studs.line_de: Ludovico schenkt ihm einen Weinberg vor der Porta Vercellina.
studs.document: the ducal grant
gaps: Present document holder not established by the cited catalog row.

studs.line_en: The French take Milan. Leonardo da Vinci leaves by December.
studs.line_de: Die Franzosen nehmen Mailand ein. Leonardo da Vinci verlässt die Stadt spätestens im Dezember.
studs.document: Milanese chronicles
gaps: Present document holder not established by the cited catalog row.

studs.line_en: Sabba da Castiglione later reports that Gascon crossbowmen used the clay horse as a target.
studs.line_de: Sabba da Castiglione berichtet später, gascognische Armbrustschützen hätten das Tonpferd als Zielscheibe benutzt.
studs.document: Sabba da Castiglione, Ricordi (first ed. Bologna 1546): "una così nobile & ingegnosa opera esser fatta bersaglio à balestrieri Guasconi"
gaps: Present document holder not established by the cited catalog row.

studs.line_en: A letter places him in Venice.
studs.line_de: Ein Brief belegt seinen Aufenthalt in Venedig.
studs.document: letter of Lorenzo Gusnasco da Pavia to Isabella d'Este (verify the writer's name)
gaps: Document locator or original record not verified. Read document and qualifications before presenting certainty.
Present document holder not established by the cited catalog row.

studs.line_en: Cesare Borgia names him architect and general engineer.
studs.line_de: Cesare Borgia ernennt ihn zum Architekten und Generalingenieur.
studs.document: Borgia's patent / safe-conduct
gaps: Present document holder not established by the cited catalog row.

studs.line_en: He makes the plan of Imola, generally dated to autumn 1502.
studs.line_de: Er zeichnet den Plan von Imola, der gewöhnlich auf Herbst 1502 datiert wird.
studs.document: the drawing itself, Royal Collection, Windsor, RCIN 912284 (verified), pen, ink and coloured wash, c. 440 x 602 mm
studs.qualifications_en: The drawing survives. Autumn is an approximate dating, and a precise surveying itinerary is not established here.
studs.qualifications_de: Die Zeichnung ist erhalten. Herbst ist eine ungefähre Datierung, ein genauer Vermessungsablauf ist hier nicht belegt.

studs.line_en: Vespucci names the portrait of Lisa del Giocondo and Saint Anne in a dated marginal note.
studs.line_de: Vespucci nennt das Porträt der Lisa del Giocondo und die heilige Anna in einer datierten Randnotiz.
studs.document: Agostino Vespucci's marginal note: "Apelles pictor. Ita Leonardus Vincius facit in omnibus suis picturis, ut est caput Lise del Giocondo et Anne matris virginis. Videbimus quid faciet de aula magni consilii, de qua re convenit iam cum vexillifero. 1503 8bris." Universitätsbibliothek Heidelberg, shelfmark D 7620 qt. INC (Cicero, Epistulae ad familiares, 1477)
studs.licence_line: Public domain. Marginal note of Agostino Vespucci, October 1503, in Cicero, Epistulae ad familiares (1477). Universitatsbibliothek Heidelberg, shelfmark D 7620 qt. INC.

studs.line_en: The Anghiari contract records payment and sets a deadline for the cartoon.
studs.line_de: Der Anghiari-Vertrag verzeichnet eine Zahlung und setzt eine Frist für den Karton.
studs.document: the Signoria's contract
gaps: Present document holder not established by the cited catalog row.

studs.line_en: He records his father's death. Richter reads 9 July, Herzfeld 7 July.
studs.line_de: Er hält den Tod seines Vaters fest. Richter liest den 9. Juli, Herzfeld den 7. Juli.
studs.document: Leonardo's own note
studs.qualifications_en: The historical editions disagree on the day. Neither translation silently corrects the other.
studs.qualifications_de: Die historischen Ausgaben widersprechen sich beim Tag. Keine Übersetzung wird stillschweigend nach der anderen berichtigt.
gaps: Present document holder not established by the cited catalog row.
Competing date readings preserved in date_alternatives.

studs.line_en: Charles d'Amboise asks Florence to let him remain in Milan for two months.
studs.line_de: Charles d'Amboise bittet Florenz, ihn zwei Monate in Mailand bleiben zu lassen.
studs.document: the letter
gaps: Present document holder not established by the cited catalog row.

studs.line_en: He develops plans for the Trivulzio equestrian monument, approximately 1507 to 1511.
studs.line_de: Er entwickelt Pläne für das Reiterdenkmal Trivulzios, ungefähr zwischen 1507 und 1511.
studs.document: the drawings and the cost estimate in the Codex Atlanticus
studs.holder: Veneranda Biblioteca Ambrosiana and Royal Collection

studs.line_en: Anatomical studies span about 1508 to 1513. Vasari later names della Torre as a collaborator.
studs.line_de: Anatomische Studien entstehen etwa zwischen 1508 und 1513. Vasari nennt später della Torre als Mitarbeiter.
studs.document: the Windsor anatomical sheets; Vasari's Life

studs.line_en: He records his departure for Rome with Melzi, Salaì, Lorenzo and il Fanfoia.
studs.line_de: Er notiert seine Abreise nach Rom mit Melzi, Salaì, Lorenzo und il Fanfoia.
studs.document: Leonardo’s dated note, Paris Ms E 1r. Richter 1465. Catalog Codex Atlanticus reference corrected by the cross-check.
studs.holder: Bibliothèque de l’Institut de France, Paris Ms E 1r
studs.qualifications_en: Cross-check corrects the catalog’s Codex Atlanticus location to Paris Ms E 1r.
studs.qualifications_de: Die Gegenprüfung berichtigt den Katalogverweis auf den Codex Atlanticus zu Paris Ms E 1r.

studs.line_en: Later writers describe a mechanical lion for a royal entry. Its location and occasion remain uncertain.
studs.line_de: Spätere Autoren beschreiben einen mechanischen Löwen für einen königlichen Einzug. Ort und Anlass bleiben unsicher.
studs.document: no contemporary record found by this drawer. The story is transmitted by later writers (Lomazzo, then Amoretti). The 19th-century chronology places the lion at Pavia, not Lyon
gaps: Present document holder not established by the cited catalog row.

studs.line_en: He enters the service of Francis I and lives at Cloux.
studs.line_de: Er tritt in den Dienst von Franz I. und wohnt in Cloux.
studs.document: the royal accounts (not seen by this drawer)
studs.qualifications_en: The source account was not inspected. The catalog’s pension figure is not asserted in display copy.
studs.qualifications_de: Der Quellenbeleg wurde nicht eingesehen. Die Rentensumme des Katalogs wird im Ausstellungstext nicht behauptet.
gaps: Document locator or original record not verified. Read document and qualifications before presenting certainty.
Present document holder not established by the cited catalog row.

studs.line_en: A dated note places him at Cloux near Amboise.
studs.line_de: Eine datierte Notiz belegt seinen Aufenthalt in Cloux bei Amboise.
studs.document: Leonardo’s dated note, Codex Atlanticus 284r, old 103r-b.
studs.qualifications_en: This is a dated presence, not proof that no earlier record exists. Modern CA 284r, old 103r-b.
studs.qualifications_de: Dies ist ein datierter Aufenthalt, kein Beweis für das Fehlen älterer Belege. Heute CA 284r, früher 103r-b.

studs.line_en: De Beatis records the visit, three paintings and an impairment of Leonardo's right hand.
studs.line_de: De Beatis hält den Besuch, drei Gemälde und eine Beeinträchtigung von Leonardos rechter Hand fest.
studs.document: travel diary of Antonio de Beatis
studs.holder: Biblioteca Nazionale di Napoli, Antonio de Beatis itinerary (shelfmark unverified)
studs.qualifications_en: The witness reports an impairment. Diagnosis and the exact visit hour are not documented. The unnamed Florentine portrait is commonly identified as the Mona Lisa, with a commission-history difficulty.
studs.qualifications_de: Der Zeuge beschreibt eine Beeinträchtigung. Diagnose und genaue Besuchsstunde sind nicht belegt. Das unbenannte Florentiner Porträt wird gewöhnlich als Mona Lisa identifiziert, bei widersprüchlicher Auftragsgeschichte.

studs.line_en: He makes his will at Cloux. Its text survives in copies.
studs.line_de: Er macht sein Testament in Cloux. Der Text ist in Abschriften erhalten.
studs.document: the original is lost. The text survives through copies, including an Italian translation addressed to his half-brother
studs.qualifications_en: The original will is lost. A text transmitted in copies is the evidence.
studs.qualifications_de: Das Originaltestament ist verloren. Der in Abschriften überlieferte Text ist der Beleg.
gaps: Present document holder not established by the cited catalog row.

studs.line_en: Leonardo da Vinci dies at Cloux. Melzi reports the death in a letter dated 1 June.
studs.line_de: Leonardo da Vinci stirbt in Cloux. Melzi berichtet davon in einem Brief vom 1. Juni.
studs.document: Francesco Melzi's letter of 1 June 1519 to Leonardo's brothers
gaps: Present document holder not established by the cited catalog row.

studs.line_en: A reported church-register entry dates his burial at Saint-Florentin to this day.
studs.line_de: Ein überlieferter Kirchenbucheintrag datiert seine Bestattung in Saint-Florentin auf diesen Tag.
studs.document: the burial entry in the church register
studs.qualifications_en: The cited account reports a register entry. The original entry and its present holder were not independently verified.
studs.qualifications_de: Die zitierte Darstellung berichtet von einem Registereintrag. Original und heutiger Aufbewahrungsort wurden nicht unabhängig geprüft.
gaps: Present document holder not established by the cited catalog row.

studs.line_en: After Melzi's death, the manuscripts pass to his son Orazio.
studs.line_de: Nach Melzis Tod gehen die Manuskripte an seinen Sohn Orazio über.
studs.document: the family record
gaps: Present document holder not established by the cited catalog row.

studs.line_en: Pompeo Leoni acquires and rearranges sheets into albums during the 1580s.
studs.line_de: Pompeo Leoni erwirbt in den 1580er Jahren Blätter und ordnet sie in Alben neu.
studs.document: the Leoni bindings themselves
gaps: Present document holder not established by the cited catalog row.

studs.line_en: Arconati gives the Codex Atlanticus and other manuscripts to the Ambrosiana.
studs.line_de: Arconati schenkt der Ambrosiana den Codex Atlanticus und weitere Manuskripte.
studs.document: the deed of donation, with its inscribed stone in the Ambrosiana

studs.line_en: French requisitions take the manuscripts to Paris.
studs.line_de: Französische Beschlagnahmungen bringen die Manuskripte nach Paris.
studs.document: the requisition lists
gaps: Present document holder not established by the cited catalog row.

studs.line_en: The Codex Atlanticus returns to Milan. The smaller manuscripts remain in Paris.
studs.line_de: Der Codex Atlanticus kehrt nach Mailand zurück. Die kleineren Manuskripte bleiben in Paris.
studs.document: the restitution records
gaps: Present document holder not established by the cited catalog row.

studs.line_en: Houssaye excavates Saint-Florentin and identifies remains as Leonardo's. That identification is unproved.
studs.line_de: Houssaye gräbt in Saint-Florentin und deutet gefundene Überreste als diejenigen Leonardos. Die Identifizierung ist unbewiesen.
studs.document: the excavation report
studs.qualifications_en: The excavation and the attribution of the bones are different claims. Only the excavation is documented.
studs.qualifications_de: Die Ausgrabung und die Zuordnung der Knochen sind verschiedene Aussagen. Nur die Ausgrabung ist belegt.
gaps: Present document holder not established by the cited catalog row.

studs.line_en: The presumed remains are transferred to Saint-Hubert. The catalog gives 1874, which the holder citation does not firmly establish.
studs.line_de: Die mutmaßlichen Überreste werden nach Saint-Hubert überführt. Der Katalog nennt 1874, die zitierte Schlossquelle belegt dieses Jahr nicht eindeutig.
studs.document: the château's own account, which dates the move to the mid-19th century
studs.qualifications_en: The year 1874 remains a catalog claim awaiting a precise holder citation. The remains are presumed.
studs.qualifications_de: Das Jahr 1874 bleibt eine Katalogangabe ohne präzisen Beleg des Schlosses. Die Überreste sind mutmaßlich.

studs.line_en: The Mona Lisa is stolen from the Louvre.
studs.line_de: Die Mona Lisa wird aus dem Louvre gestohlen.
studs.document: police and press record
gaps: Present document holder not established by the cited catalog row.

studs.line_en: The stolen Mona Lisa is recovered in Florence.
studs.line_de: Die gestohlene Mona Lisa wird in Florenz wiedergefunden.
studs.document: police record
gaps: Present document holder not established by the cited catalog row.

studs.line_en: Milan opens a major Leonardo exhibition and a display of Italian inventions under Fascist rule.
studs.line_de: Mailand eröffnet unter faschistischer Herrschaft eine große Leonardo-Ausstellung und eine Schau italienischer Erfindungen.
studs.document: the exhibition catalogue and archive
gaps: Present document holder not established by the cited catalog row.

studs.line_en: Bill Gates buys the Codex Leicester at auction for 30,802,500 US dollars.
studs.line_de: Bill Gates ersteigert den Codex Leicester für 30.802.500 US-Dollar.
studs.document: the auction record

studs.line_en: The Vespucci note is identified in Heidelberg. Wider public attention follows later.
studs.line_de: Die Vespucci-Notiz wird in Heidelberg identifiziert. Größere öffentliche Aufmerksamkeit folgt später.
studs.document: the book itself
studs.qualifications_en: Distinguish identification in 2005 from announcements and publication in 2008.
studs.qualifications_de: Die Identifizierung 2005 ist von Bekanntmachungen und Veröffentlichungen 2008 zu unterscheiden.
studs.licence_line: Public domain. Marginal note of Agostino Vespucci, October 1503, in Cicero, Epistulae ad familiares (1477). Universitatsbibliothek Heidelberg, shelfmark D 7620 qt. INC.

studs.line_en: Salvator Mundi sells for 450.3 million US dollars including fees. Its attribution remains disputed.
studs.line_de: Salvator Mundi wird einschließlich Gebühren für 450,3 Millionen US-Dollar verkauft. Die Zuschreibung bleibt umstritten.
studs.document: the sale record
gaps: Present document holder not established by the cited catalog row.

studs.line_en: The Louvre opens its Leonardo exhibition. It later reports 1,071,840 visits.
studs.line_de: Der Louvre eröffnet seine Leonardo-Ausstellung. Später meldet er 1.071.840 Besuche.
studs.document: the Louvre's own press release

design.spacing: Evenly legible studs within each bay. Not proportional to elapsed time.
design.hour_certainty: Chosen museum anchor. The diary does not record this minute.
design.afterlife: Rows after 1519 belong to the later reception of the work, not to Leonardo’s witnessed lifetime.
